title: Muradiye Mosque, Edirne
scope: Standing Muradiye Mosque on the hill above Edirne, with the paired axial domes, lower lateral tabhane domes, north porch and one minaret.
limitations: Architectural descriptions and mapped outline inform the standing exterior. Individual drum, eave and minaret heights, the exact portal detail and trim colours are estimated.
The current stone minaret is represented. The separate lodge, courtyard fountain, burial grounds, historic tilework and interior are outside the model scope.
Original Terrarium heights preserve the hill slope. Steps, paving, retaining walls and the immediate ground around the mosque are simplified.
